findings.text: the terminal-status filter suppresses endpoint-without-handle for a structural endpoint whose endpoint plan is terminal, an exception absent from the exact section contract: the live plan says a structurally endpoint plan carrying no handle raises the finding, and its locked rationale says every structural endpoint should report until a handle is authored. A direct probe with a shipped closed-endpoint depending on a live-foundation confirmed endpoints=[closed-endpoint] while terminal_findings=[]; none of the four added tests exercises a terminal endpoint. Remove this skip or first record an explicit plan decision authorising the lifecycle exception, then add the terminal case to the gate.
